provenance.design: Full factorial: 5 construction target classes x 6 data-sufficiency coverage tiers, 30 profiles per stratum, plus 100 tagged edge cases.
provenance.usage_restriction: ROBUSTNESS AND STRESS TESTING ONLY. construction_target_class records which rubric cell each profile was sampled to fill and is NOT ground truth. evaluation/datasets.py refuses to expose it as such. Any accuracy, precision, recall or F1 number computed from this file would be measuring the sampler, not the model.
